Minimotors EY3 LCD Display Throttle

The Minimotors EY3 is an advanced integrated unit that combines an LCD display and an ergonomic finger throttle into one device. It is designed for monitoring scooter status and controlling acceleration through responsive speed regulation.

Features and Functions

  • Integrated Unit: Combines a data display and finger throttle for streamlined control.
  • Data Tracking: Provides real-time information including speed, distance, riding time, and battery level.
  • Installation: Features a plug-and-play setup for compatible models.
  • Controls: Features responsive components for precise speed regulation and acceleration.

Compatibility

This display throttle is compatible with select electric scooters, including:

  • Dualtron models
  • Speedway models
  • Mantis Pro
  • Wolf Warrior 11
  • Select Kaabo models

Specifications and Requirements

  • Throttle wire sold separately.
  • Mounting bracket is not included and must be purchased separately.
